title: A widely used antibiotic for acne and infections is linked to risk of pregnancy loss, new study finds
caption:
A common antibiotic used for acne and infections is linked to a higher risk of pregnancy loss in the first trimester. A new study analyzed over 200,000 pregnancies to compare outcomes for those using doxycycline versus other options.

Source: Livescience - A widely used antibiotic for acne and infections is linked to risk of pregnancy loss, new study finds

https://www.livescience.com/health/reproductive-health/a-widely-used-antibiotic-for-acne-and-infections-is-linked-to-risk-of-pregnancy-loss-new-study-finds
